differences.what: The write-up's explicit framing of novelty relative to named antecedents (activation addition, contrastive activation addition) is not mentioned at all in the message's Origin discussion; the message instead frames the large-dose/narrow-peak behaviour as a recognized prior pattern without naming any antecedent paper
differences.writeup_quote: It draws on activation addition and contrastive activation addition, but the stance contrast, the mid-depth band, and the large dose are chosen anew here.

rationale: The write-up's only novelty/origin discussion names general prior techniques (activation addition, contrastive activation addition) and claims the stance contrast, band, and large dose were 'chosen anew,' never naming or clearly pointing to the specific white-bear/Raman-2026 source. The closing message never names that source either, but it drops an indirect hint — calling the narrow, large-dose effect the 'known... behaviour of stance steering' — implying an established prior finding, which is a claim of precedent the write-up does not make for that specific phenomenon, while the write-up's explicit 'chosen anew' novelty framing is absent from the message.
